marketplace.note: Recipe packs. No payments, no live logins, no secrets.

groups.name: Personal Assistant
groups.departmentJob: General-purpose personal assistant for research, drafting, scheduling, reminders, and computer-use on a virtualized desktop. Neutral; no business-specific instructions.
groups.author: Dragon AI
groups.blurb: Default one-bot profile. Already installed; not a Teams marketplace row.

groups.name: Real Estate Cold Call Lead Refresher
groups.departmentJob: Outbound real-estate department: refresh stale leads, warm them with CAN-SPAM email toward a TCPA consent form, write cold-call scripts, and sequence follow-ups.
groups.blurb: Refresh stale leads, warm them, write scripts, and follow up.
groups.detail: Outbound real-estate recipe pack. Four seats: Lead Sourcer, Email Warmer, Cold Call Script Writer, and Follow-up Sequencer. Connector placeholders only (CRM, email, TCPA consent form, dialer, property data). No live CRM or mailbox logins and no API keys in the pack.
groups.author: Dragon AI

groups.name: Marketing Team
groups.departmentJob: Content, SEO, social, paid, lifecycle, and measurement for a marketing desk.
groups.blurb: Six Cos seats for content, SEO, social, paid, lifecycle, and measurement.
groups.detail: Marketing desk recipe pack. Exactly six Cos seats: Content Strategist, SEO Specialist, Social Media Manager, Paid Media Specialist, Lifecycle Marketer, and Marketing Analyst. No seventh seat. Browser and computer-use tools only in this tree. Not a live Buffer/Brevo login pack.
groups.author: Dragon AI

groups.name: Trading Team
groups.departmentJob: Research notes, news scan, risk review, and a trade journal for a discretionary desk. Not brokerage, not auto-trading.
groups.blurb: Research notes, news scan, risk review, and a trade journal. Not a broker.
groups.detail: Discretionary desk recipe pack. Four seats: Market Researcher, Trade Journal, Risk Analyst, and News Scanner. Summarizes public context the operator provides. Does not place orders, hold brokerage credentials, or auto-trade.
groups.author: Dragon AI
